schema: CREATE TABLE EMPLOYEE ( EMP_NUM INT PRIMARY KEY, EMP_LNAME VARCHAR(15), EMP_FNAME VARCHAR(12), EMP_INITIAL VARCHAR(1), EMP_JOBCODE VARCHAR(5), EMP_HIREDATE INT, EMP_DOB INT ); CREATE TABLE DEPARTMENT ( DEPT_CODE VARCHAR(10) PRIMARY KEY, EMP_NUM INT, DEPT_NAME VARCHAR(30), SCHOOL_CODE VARCHAR(8), DEPT_ADDRESS VARCHAR(20), DEPT_EXTENSION VARCHAR(4), FOREIGN KEY (EMP_NUM) REFERENCES EMPLOYEE(EMP_NUM) ); CREATE TABLE PROFESSOR ( DEPT_CODE VARCHAR(10), EMP_NUM INT, PROF_OFFICE VARCHAR(50), PROF_EXTENSION VARCHAR(4), PROF_HIGH_DEGREE VARCHAR(5), FOREIGN KEY (DEPT_CODE) REFERENCES DEPARTMENT(DEPT_CODE), FOREIGN KEY (EMP_NUM) REFERENCES EMPLOYEE(EMP_NUM) );
correct_query: SELECT LHS.emp_fname, RHS.prof_office FROM (SELECT LHS.dept_code, LHS.dept_name, LHS.school_code, LHS.emp_num, LHS.dept_address, LHS.dept_extension, RHS.emp_lname, RHS.emp_fname, RHS.emp_initial, RHS.emp_jobcode, RHS.emp_hiredate, RHS.emp_dob FROM DEPARTMENT AS LHS INNER JOIN EMPLOYEE AS RHS ON LHS.emp_num = RHS.emp_num) AS LHS INNER JOIN PROFESSOR AS RHS ON LHS.dept_code = RHS.dept_code AND LHS.emp_num = RHS.emp_num WHERE dept_name = 'History' AND prof_high_degree = 'Ph.D.'

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT T1.emp_fname, T2.prof_office FROM EMPLOYEE AS T1 JOIN PROFESSOR AS T2 ON T1.emp_num = T2.emp_num JOIN DEPARTMENT AS T3 ON T3.dept_code = T2.dept_code WHERE T3.dept_name = 'History' AND T2.prof_high_degree = 'Ph.D.'
